translation.title: Loxoprofen Sodium Cataplasm (Pap)
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of osteoarthritis (degenerative arthritis), muscle pain, and swelling and pain after an injury.
translation.usage: Apply 1 cataplasm to the affected area once a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, or if you have or have had aspirin-induced asthma (an asthma attack caused by non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics). Do not use it on the eyes or mucous membranes, on damaged skin or mucous membranes, on areas with eczema or rash, or on areas affected by athlete's foot or ringworm. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have bronchial asthma, if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, breastfeeding, a premature baby, a newborn, an infant, a young child, a child, or elderly. If your symptoms do not improve after about one week of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed directions and dosage. Do not use an occlusive dressing. Itching, redness, contact dermatitis, skin rash, subcutaneous bleeding, skin irritation, pigmentation, blisters, swelling, abdominal discomfort, upper abdominal pain, diarrhoea or loose stools, increased ALT, increased AST, increased gamma-GTP, oedema, or shock symptoms (a drop in blood pressure, hives, laryngeal oedema, difficulty breathing) may occur. If any of these occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature away from moisture and light, and keep out of reach of children.
